notes: New: the Omen editor has a Deck step (Position, Layout, Deck, Layers, Configure; God Mode for now). Pick a split (All Omen, Omen two thirds, Omen one third), Omen left or right, one or two rows; tap a space on the live picture to set what…
New: premade runes only: Sound, Media player, Power plan, Power buttons, Shortcuts and Web page. The Layout step no longer carries the split, spaces or key builder.
Change: the Shortcuts rune shows your saved shortcuts (set in the Control Panel), and says so when there are none.
New: Web page rune: Discord, Twitch chat, Twitch stream, YouTube or any https page, set on the Deck step; you sign in inside the page.
Change: the Cards deck draws its controls in the Omen's own form and line, with icons beside every word.
